rooms.name: An Immortal Room
rooms.desc:
This is a starting point for all of us who don't need doors or walkways to get
around.  There is a map floating in the nothingness here for some guidance.

rooms.name: A Foreboding Cave Entrance
rooms.desc:
An unusually dark cave opening looms northward, its walls covered with strange
writings, apparently in a number of different languages.  You can make out
one word, which apparently reads: 'Danger'.  You notice two tall spears, one
on each side of the cave, topped with skulls.  A rather large pile of bones
has gathered in the area, and perhaps it'd be best to leave before you joined
them.

rooms.name: A Peaceful Meditation Room
rooms.desc:
The cave here has an unusually peaceful and relaxed feeling.  A comfortable
mat lies in front of a bookcase on the north wall.  A ninja's book of
meditations lies open on the mat, suggesting that the owner has been here
recently; perhaps it would be best to leave before he returns.

rooms.name: The Chamber of Wisdom
rooms.desc:
A surprisingly well-lit room surrounds you.  There are no visible torches or
even signs of magical intervention, but there is more than enough light to see
clearly.  An open book stands on a pedestal in the center of the room, with
some neat writing, which appears to read: 'Through conquest comes knowledge.'

rooms.name: An Ambient Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You enter a tunnel lit by glowing crystals. As the damp, dusk air fills
your nostrils, you catch the scent of something foul. Your nose guides you
to its source, a homeless bum. He has fallen asleep on apparently quite a
comfortable stack of newspapers. Near him stands an old shopping cart filled
with what appears to be pickle jars of water. Behind this cart is the man's
home, an old cardboard box reading "this side up" on the top.
   Pulsating from the north, you feel waves of warmth and tranquility. From
the east, you hear jeers and cheers from what you assume to be some sort of
battle arena.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Arena
rooms.desc:
You stand in a room filled with people, some suiting up for battle, others
gambling on the outcome of the next match. Cries of pain and victory echo in
from the east. Every once in a while, the crowd roars in pleasure as another
poor soul has had his life cut short.

rooms.name: The Altar of Nat
rooms.desc:
Upon arriving in this room, you instantly feel at peace. In the center is
a statue of a radiant woman, eminating pulses of light throughout the room.
Sacrificial offerings of elaborately crafted treasures of all kinds glitter
in the ever constant light. Covering the walls are various pictures and other
relics depicting the Goddess Nat. You feel drawn near to the statue and the
feeling of relaxation flows through your body. In her presence you are lost
in the ecstasy of content and you wish time would stop.

rooms.name: A Curious Cave
rooms.desc:
A delicately chiseled stairwell with a smooth marble hand rail leads to
the upper floor. To the north lies a door reading "Authorized Personnel Only!"
Beyond the door, you think you hear the drops of many small metal objects.
To the west you hear a man yell "Hey Ma!" To the east comes a feeling of
refreshment and content - your curiousity wanders in all directions.

rooms.name: A Long Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You enter a long tunnel lined with portraits of what you guess to be old
dead people. Your curiousity takes over you and you feel the impulse to look
at each one. To the west, you swear you hear a man yell "Hey Ma!" To the east,
you can sense the void of a large open cavern.

rooms.name: The Room of Portals
rooms.desc:
You come into a room that seems well travelled with walls covered in all
manner of runes and magickal symbols that you can't even begin to comprehend.
Electricity seems to flow from over your body like a blanket and causes your
hair to stand on end. Near the western wall is a metal sign which simply reads
"Route 66" with arrows pointing to the north and south. Out of nowhere, you
think you hear an old woman say "We gots to get acrost..."

rooms.name: Top of the Stairs
rooms.desc:
Entering the room at the top of the stairwell, you first notice a large
case displaying various ninja weapons. On the far wall is a shiny new door
with a square glass window at eye level. The sounds of splashing water and
girls giggling perk your ears as you see puddles of water forming beneath the
door. There is also a metal reinforced door to the east made from thick
mahogany - there is nothing but dead silence coming from the other side.

rooms.name: The Jacuzzi Room
rooms.desc:
The vaguely detectable scent of sulphur is masked by the fragrance from
numerous rose petals littering the floor. Two developing, beautiful girls sit
at the edge of a large, warm, bubbling, oval shaped tub. Such exotic treats
could not be seen anywhere but here - everyone says I love you but these two
professional girls seem to know exactly where the heart is. Phantom menaces
be gone for the heat given off gives you the most soothing feeling of
relaxation you have ever felt.

rooms.name: A Sauna Room
rooms.desc:
As you step into the sauna, your immediate response is one of immense
pleasure and enticing pain. The aroma of cedar fills your nostrils with the
sweet scent of fresh wood but as you inhale deeper, there is a searing pain
from the intense heat. On a small mantel hangs an oak bucket, half filled
with water which leaks out the side and over a number of heated rocks. The
rocks themselves are heated directly by the hall furnace which burns
continuously to warm the rooms deep within the heart of the mountain. A row
of robes hanging on a series of pegs protrudes from one wall, beckoning you
to strip down and enjoy the muscle soothing heat.

rooms.name: The Board Room
rooms.desc:
A large oaken table demands the attention of all who enter. Your first
reaction is one of amazement at the intricate craftmanship that went into its
features, then you notice that it hasn't just been carved from a single piece
of wood but rather a living tree carefully crafted in the manner of skilled
wood elves. Tiny limbs with pale leaves are noticeable on the legs that
seamlessly melt into the root system. You can't resist moving one of the
chairs to confirm that they are indeed chairs with ornate carvings and not
another component of the elves' work.

rooms.name: A Grand View of the Skies
rooms.desc:
As you enter the room, the most obvious feature is the large, gaping hole
in the ceiling. Looking upward, your eyes become lost in the infiniteness of
the sky which is ablaze with all shades of red. There is a large metal door
to the east and a thick, wood door to the west. This room, however, is
eerily quiet yet tranquil.

rooms.name: An Array of Treasures
rooms.desc:
The room glitters of treasures from far off lands - priceless jewels and
rubies overflow a large wooden chest in the corner. Along the wall, swords
and weapons of all shapes and sizes are displayed along a large rack.
The materials with which many of these weapons are forged are new to you
and you wince at the thought of any of these actually causing pain to you. Off
to the side are full suits of armor worn on wooden mannequins.

rooms.name: Within the Arena
rooms.desc:
The tunnel opens up into an enourmous cave, wafts of smoke passing you
by at ankle level. The floor is simple dirt, stained with blood in some
places and displaying the tell-tale signs of battle.

rooms.name: Within the Arena
rooms.desc:
You make your way around the enormous arena, always on guard awaiting
your next foe. Corpses lie at irregular intervals, perhaps an indication of
what is to come...

rooms.name: Outside the Golden Pyramid
rooms.desc:
You stand at the top of a small trail in the foothills of the Grey Mountains.
Before you is a squat, golden pyramid that shines with an unnatural light.
The rune-covered entryway is to your north, while to the south the small,
rocky trail decends back down the foothills into the open plains.  The Grey
Mountains loom high above your head in all other directions.

rooms.name: Inside the Golden Pyramid
rooms.desc:
You are now inside the golden pyramid. The walls appear to be constructed
from solid gold. A pungent green smoke fills the air, choking your lungs and
leaving you confused. You can hear strange singing from an unknown direction,
some type of folk music. On the floor lay three golden lamps, each emblazoned
with an apple.

rooms.name: The Gallery
rooms.desc:
This is where the inhabitants apparently hold all important meetings.
Topless women stand in all corners of the room, standing so still you almost
didn't realize they were real. A large table is in the center of the room,
with thirty chairs around it. Foot high golden letters across one wall read
FREEDOM DEFINED IS FREEDOM DENIED'. The green smoke has made you very curious
about this place, and you think you understand the meaning of the words. You
don't thought, for you have never been free. Perhaps the owners of this place
will teach you.

rooms.name: A Shrine to the Goddess
rooms.desc:
This room is a shrine to a goddess. By looking around the room, you can't
tell exactly what kind of goddess she is, though. There is a sacred feel about
the room, or maybe it's just the blasted green smoke. An altar is here, and a
golden apple is smoldering on it. The smoke is apparently coming from there.
   There is a glowing hole in the northern wall that reflects all of your
light and yet, it has no surface that you can see.

rooms.name: The Rumpus Room
rooms.desc:
Apparently the crew that runs this place takes nothing seriously. The green
smoke you noticed upstairs is now almost impossibly thick down here. You'd be
coughing and choking right now, if you hadn't started to like the way it's
making you feel. Bunks and couches are strewn everywhere, and half-naked men
stroke half-naked women to ecstasy on all of them, except of course the ones
where the half-naked women are stroking the half-naked men. Some of them are
singing, and all of them seem happy.

rooms.name: A Peaceful Sanctum
rooms.desc:
In the center of this room, painted onto the floor is a large white peace
sign. The walls are lined with cabinets containing valuable weapons and armors.
From here you can walk west into the shrine, south into a room that appears
to be the site of a party or down a set of stairs. There is a large, wooden
door inset into the eastern wall.

rooms.name: The Gladitorial Pit
rooms.desc:
You step into a room that is devoid of the green smoke which fills the
previous chambers. You look around and notice the wall is lined with an arsenal
of weapons. Scimitars, two-handed blades, and wicked-looking daggers dominate
all of the walls. All of them could cut down an ironwood tree in one swipe.
Suddenly you hear a voice call out "PREPARE YOURSELF."

rooms.name: A Smoke-Filled Room
rooms.desc:
As soon as you enter this room the smoke changes from green, to black, 
and then to blue and the pungent odor changes to a sweet, heavenly aroma. 
The smoke is so dense, you cannot see your light inches from your face, 
but oddly enough, you see the ground and walls clearly. Suddenly the room 
swirls and you feel like you are floating. You can't discern up from down 
but you see peculiar arrangements of stones everywhere you look.

rooms.name: Spare
rooms.desc:
Descending down the stairs, you see two sconces with lit candles flanking
either side of the enormous stone door providing seemingly endless
illumination. Everything here looks very old and the smell of decay is
overwhelming. Water leaks from the ceiling in some places, bringing with it
a monotonous dripping noise while puddles form in the corners of the room.
Faint light glows upon moss creeping up the cold walls, producing the only
color in this desolate black and grey environment.
   Exits lead up the stairs back into the Pyramid and south deeper into the
tomb.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Caelitis Monastery
rooms.desc:
An extremely large wrought iron gate blocks the entrance to this sanctified
monastery.  The beautiful oratory can be seen through the bars of the gate
while the tops of several other buildings are visible over the surrounding
wall.  Heavily guarded by two of the toughest monks you have ever seen, you
find no easy way to break into this sacred realm.

rooms.name: Inside the Monastery
rooms.desc:
Through the wrought iron gate thrives a highly structured monastery
consisting of several brick and clay buildings.  Resident monks along with
nomadic friars frequent this abbey in search of peace and tranquility.  The
main sanctuary of this place of worship lies to the north, while a line of
friars files out from the small building to the east.

rooms.name: Temple Foyer
rooms.desc:
The entrance to this sacred temple is marked by copious ornate paintings and
sculptures reflecting the spiritual beliefs of the monastery.  Light refracts
into the room through the stained-glass windows lining the walls.  A smaller
shrine sits outside the door leading to the oratory allowing monks to perform
additional prayer rituals before they enter.

rooms.name: A Summoning Pit
rooms.desc:
The shrieks of daemons and other lesser beings echo throughout the pit while
the dense stone walls prevent the sounds from reaching the temple.  The pit is
dark and sinister with only a torch flickering and casting the shadows dancing
across the room.  The light reveals vicious claw marks and several indentations
in the walls caused by the vile creatures being summoned here.

rooms.name: Caelitis Oratory
rooms.desc:
A small walkway files through the middle of the pews towards the hallowed
altar.  Sculpted from the finest white marble in the land, this altar radiates
with sanctity.  Several small pillows are placed in front of the altar for
those who wish to worship on their knees.  The gentle hum of angels resounds
throughout the oratory off of the solid limestone walls enclosing the area.
Two solid gold hinges fastened to the wooden floor catch your eye from
underneath one of the back pews.

rooms.name: High Amongst the Clouds
rooms.desc:
As the staircase continues to ascend towards the heavens, the air becomes
thin and the sun glimmers off of the clouds.  The sounds of birds and other
noises fade in the distance as the only sound is the gentle breeze.  The end
of this seemingly infinite stairway remains far out of sight.

rooms.name: A Harem in the Skyy.
rooms.desc:
Several oversized pillows wrapped in ivory-coloured silk cases
lay atop the bed of clouds.  Atop a small table amidst these pillows
rests an ancient hookah, still smoking from recent use.  White and
cream-coloured sheets have been loosely draped over the bed, meshing
the heavenly atmosphere with the sensualness of its inhabitants.  Three
beautiful women lay scantily-clad on the bed, awaiting their master's
return to fulfill his every desire.

rooms.name: Donations House
rooms.desc:
This small brick hut stores numerous offerings of food and clothing for the
impoverished friars.  Several wooden crates are stocked full of donations,
overflowing onto the ground.  These alms of goodwill have been collected by the
members of this monastery to provide aid to all needy souls of the realm.

rooms.name: Azarith's Bedroom
rooms.desc:
A blinding amount of light streams in from the floor-to-ceiling windows of
this room overlooking the monastery.  An enormous, ornate bed with gold
bedposts sits against the side wall, complete with a set of red satin bedding.
The adjacent wall is entirely shelved and covered with a vast array of books
and manuscripts.  Numerous mahogany dressers, bureaus and wardrobes are
placed about the room on a spotless, marble-tiled floor, leaving no doubt that
the owner of this room enjoys a lavish lifestyle.  It is difficult to adjust to
the light, but a large, oak-trimmed mirror can be distinguished and sits 
directly in front of the door.  Shadows dancing in the corners of the mirror
give the impression that a large man is lurking somewhere behind the door.

rooms.name: Seraphim Lobby
rooms.desc:
High above the rest of the clouds lays this small white blanket of vapor
lofted in the upper reaches of the atmosphere.  A rich mahogany table replete
with the day's agenda is positioned in the center of the cloud with several
surrounding chairs fashioned from the same timber.  This area serves as a
congregation room for those who have ascended to the highest level of the
heaven walkers.

rooms.name: The Sacrifical Altar
rooms.desc:
Large, cathedral-styled windows line the walls of this bleak, stone-furnished
room.  Instead of the usual primitive religious art staining the glass of these
windows, black, blood-stained sheets have been crudely nailed into the frames
and blot out nearly all outside light.  Books containing arcane knowledge with
titles written in forgotten languages seem to be scattered haphazardly around
the bare stone floor.  In the center of the room is a granite table marked with
an array of mysterious and ominous symbols.  A thick, red liquid, possibly
blood, flows down grooves carved into the side of the table into a rusted metal
grating in the floor.  Through it, the screams of tormented souls who met
torturous ends at the hands of a skilled assassin can be heard.  A flash of
lightning briefly illuminates the room and a message scrawled in 
blood on the far wall helps provide insight into the feverish madness of a man
vainly chasing the specter of immortality.

rooms.name: A Garden Terrace
rooms.desc:
The monastic garden comes to an end at a very striking veranda.  The white
limestone pillars in conjunction with the intricate marble flooring make this
terrace glisten in the sunlight.  The terrace appears to be where the
monastery's financial endeavors take place as a small friar stands watch over
the banking facility.  An elaborate ivory stairway was built here, leading
endlessly into the heavens.

rooms.name: A Garden Path
rooms.desc:
The dirt path continues to weave through the lustrous gardens of the
monastery.  Luscious fruit trees line the path dropping fresh, delicious
fruits onto the path for the monks to enjoy.  Several smaller ponds are
scattered throughout the gardens with several breeds of geese floating
atop the water.

rooms.name: Monastic Gardens
rooms.desc:
Fresh air fills the atmosphere of these lush gardens with the ambient sounds
of birds chirping and leaves rustling in the wind.  Several statues 
inhabit the earth of these gardens, serving as a tribute to former members and
important allies of the monastery.  A small dirt trail leads through the
greenery towards a beautiful white limestone terrace.

rooms.name: Behind the Altar
rooms.desc:
The natural darkness of this small room is contrasted by the gleaming light
from three large portals.  The vibrant colors reflect off of the walls,
creating an iridescent glow to complement the gentle hum of the portals.
A small sign is posted on the wall giving some indication as to where these
portals lead.

rooms.name: The Ground floor of a Tall Tower
rooms.desc:
You stand just inside an enormous granite tower. A flight of spiral stairs
leads upward to the next floor, passing through two glowing spheres of 
magickal light. Tapestries adorn the walls, showing a powerful-looking mage
pitted against a variety of creatures, many the likes of which you have never
encountered.

rooms.name: The Second Floor of a Tall Tower
rooms.desc:
The great spiral staircase takes up most of this room, leading down to
the ground floor and up further into the tower. A flowering garden of assorted
herbs and perennials surrounds the flowing fountain that takes up the center
of the room. To the south, an archway opens onto a large balcony while to the
north, shimmers of light dance around the room.

rooms.name: The Room of Portals
rooms.desc:
You enter a rather sparse room which holds no interest whatsoever apart
from the glowing portals on the western, northern and eastern walls. Each
reflects all sources of light creating an interesting effect within the room
as if the light itself were alive and dancing around you. Above the northern
portal is a small wooden sign.

rooms.name: The Second Floor Balcony
rooms.desc:
The balcony affords a relatively good view of the surrounding forest
although the density of trees prevents you from seeing too much further
through them. From here, you could easily make it down to the base of the
tower but getting back up may be a problem.

rooms.name: At the Base of a Tall Tower
rooms.desc:
Above you rises a tall tower of cold granite. The entrance to the north is a
large ironwood door, easily large enough to pass a wagon through.

rooms.name: The Third Floor of a Tall Tower
rooms.desc:
The great spiral staircase takes up most of this room, leading down to
the second floor and up further into the tower. There is a certain chill in
the air and you shiver uncomfortably but the feeling soon passes and you are
left standing here.

rooms.name: The Fourth Floor of a Tall Tower
rooms.desc:
The great spiral staircase takes up most of this room, leading down to
the ground floor and up further into the tower. There are a few comfortable
chairs scattered around and the walls have been decorated with past heroes,
some from this clan and others who strived to better themselves within this
world. The treasure room lies to the south while a strong, wooden door lies
to the north.

rooms.name: The Treasure Room
rooms.desc:
This room is adorned with gold; from the etched gold-leaf that plates the
floor to the solid gold pillars that support the floor above, the sight 
takes your breath away. The only exit from the room lies to the north.

rooms.name: The Top of a Tall Tower
rooms.desc:
Windows on all four walls are made of a magickal glass; perfectly
transparent and yet strong as rock.  The view of the countryside out them is
quite breath-taking; from the mountains to the north to the small desolate-
looking village to the west.  Runes of power are inscribed into the ceiling
here, and a small pentagram has been etched into the floor.

rooms.name: The Room of Solitude
rooms.desc:
This cozy room is dominated by a large, wooden table which is covered in
all sorts of maps and plans. Scrolls litter the floor, most filled with the
statistics of worldly items and the weakenesses of some of the more difficult
creatures. A window in the northern wall provides a breath-taking view of the
surrounding mountains while a solid door to the south keeps out all of those
unwelcome guests.

rooms.name: The Grand Arena
rooms.desc:
The arena is similar to the colosseum's of old, an area of compacted dirt
surrounded by layers of seating high above the arena floor. Bloody corpses
have been scattered everywhere and it would be an ideal place to test your
ability.

rooms.name: The Prison of Syns
rooms.desc:
This room has been here for hundreds of years and as you pass through
the opening to the west, you can hear the spirits of the dead calling for
you. You feel them as they attempt to possess your body and mind but an
unseen force within the chamber protects you from that fate.

rooms.name: The Hall of Portals
rooms.desc:
This room is well lit by the white, misty aura eminating from the portals
on the surrounding walls. As you gaze around the room, you notice the red
carpet at its entrance to the south...perhaps you should wipe your feet
before entering.

rooms.name: A Narrow Trail
rooms.desc:
The trail continues to the north and south between high-reaching mountain
tops far above your head. To the south, the forest beckons while a solid
looking door lies to the north.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.desc:
The room is rather large and contains a single table in the center,
surrounded by a number of chairs. Emblazoned on the table is the crest for
the Etheral Syns clan - this room is obviously a meeting place for the clan
members.

rooms.name: An Open Cavern
rooms.desc:
The room opens up into a rather large cavern, the ceiling far above your
head. The rock walls have been highly polished and torches have been placed
at various points to light the room.

rooms.name: The Grand Arena
rooms.desc:
You step through a grand-looking arch and enter the clan Arena. It is
similar to the colosseum's of old, an area of compacted dirt surrounded by
layers of seating high above the arena floor. Bloody corpses have been
scattered everywhere and it would be an ideal place to test your ability.

rooms.name: A Cold, Damp Dungeon
rooms.desc:
You enter the darkness and immediately notice the chill in the air.
Water drips from an unknown source and moss grows on the brickwork despite
the lack of light. A pile of treasure sits in the corner surrounded by all
manner of bones, most of which you identify as human. You are tempted to
steal some of it but the fate of those before you seems obvious enough.

rooms.name: The Forbidden Lair
rooms.desc:
You have entered a dimly lit room, the walls stained red from the blood
of numerous victims. Broken swords, shields and human bones litter the
floor - this room was obviously used for training at one time and perhaps
the blood shed here belonged to that of its warriors.

rooms.name: The Battle Arena
rooms.desc:
Numerous corpses have been piled into the corners of this arena, not all
of them human. It appears the Knights of this castle train and develop their
skills here, both against each other and the foul beasts that lurk in the
darkened corridors. The room has been permanently stained with the blood of
hapless victims.

rooms.name: The Room of Portals
rooms.desc:
From here, the legions of hellspawn from within these walls can travel to
various locations within the realm and unleash their fury. One day, they shall
conquer the world...

rooms.name: The Castle Entrance
rooms.desc:
You stand beneath a giant archway, the entrance to this foul place. The
floors and walls are made of a cold stone and have been covered with the blood
from many fearsome battles...some of it looks quite fresh. Large rooms lie to
the west and east while the exit from the castle lies to the south.

rooms.name: Walkway to a Demonic Castle
rooms.desc:
Ahead looms a large castle, encircled by a moat of molten lava and shrouded
by dark, foreboding clouds. From behind its walls come the screams of tortured
souls, crying out for mercy. A large portcullis to the north marks the
entrance to this foul place.

rooms.name: A Narrow Trail
rooms.desc:
The trail continues to the north and south between high-reaching mountain
tops far above your head. To the south, the forest beckons while a solid
looking door lies to the north.

rooms.name: Spare
rooms.desc:
Dark marble with silver lining covers the walkway, yet the ceiling here is
constructed with white marble. It is as if the floor is an inverse of the
ceiling. Where there is white below, there is black above, and the converse
is true for the ceiling relative to the floor. The overall effect is one of
opposition; however, all of the contrasting elements make up the whole of the
fortress, which carries an implicit significance.

rooms.name: Spare
rooms.desc:
To the north you can hear the sound of water coming from the western
passage. It sounds similar to that of a brook, yet less audible. The laughter
of young women is barely discernable from the western passage also, arousing
curiosity. The floor is adorned with thick sheets of white marble, and centered
upon the wall is a battle-shield painted with the Inner Sanctum's crest.

rooms.name: Spare
rooms.desc:
From the north you can hear deep, rhythmic drumming, accompanied by dark
chanting from several female voices. Blue-tinted light flickers from the south,
and on the east-wall is a large shield painted with the crest of the Inner
Sanctum. Thick slabs of white marble make up the flooring, and consistent with
the contrasting theme, the ceiling is designed with black marble.

rooms.name: Spare
rooms.desc:
An archway is draped with black cloth to the west, and one side of the
drapery is pulled aside to allow passage. Peering through the drawn curtain,
you can perceive the reflections of blue light cast upon unlit walls, and the
sounds of splashing water. East of here is the focal point of the entire
complex  the council of the Inner Sanctum. The floor here, too, is designed
with black marble.

rooms.name: The Aloazar Portal
rooms.desc:
As you enter the room, it pulses softly and the portal on the far wall
glows softly. The walls are covered in all manner of magical runes, none of
which look familiar to you. Light cascades around the room in the various
colors of the rainbow, certainly a breath-taking sight.

rooms.name: The Amber Portal
rooms.desc:
As you enter the room, you notice a large portal on the far wall which
lets off a magnificent glow. Its color and size are almost hypnotic, drawing
you ever closer. The only question that remains is, should you take the leap?

rooms.name: The Kir Oshi Portal
rooms.desc:
As you enter the room, it pulses softly and the portal on the far wall
glows softly. The walls are covered in all manner of magical runes, none of
which look familiar to you. Light cascades around the room in the various
colors of the rainbow, certainly a breath-taking sight.

rooms.name: Spare
rooms.desc:
Spectral illumination permeates the air, emanating from spherical
contraptions that hang from the ceiling east and west of you. The walkway
is raised above the surface of the floor slightly, and is paved with black
marble. Directly south from here is where the Inner Sanctum deliberates, and
to the north is the entrance to the training grounds.

rooms.name: Spare
rooms.desc:
Vibrant flares gush forth from a strange, magickal apparatus that suspends
from the ceiling. Like a multi-colored fount, purple and blue streaks of light
radiate outward with fluid motion, continually altering conformation until
evaporating into the air. On rare occasion, globular formations build up
within the apparatus, then boil over, splattering on the ground like an
oversized raindrop.
